The fixed-base fiber map H_epsilon has no primitive two-cycle, exhausting all possibilities. sin72°/sin144°=(1+sqrt5)/2 irrational forbids simultaneous resonances. verify.py passes exact base arithmetic and representative matrix/identity checks; those finite checks are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 3-torus cat-driven Möbius system is studied specifically via its shortest nontrivial driving periodic orbits to understand collisions. Here the global exact primitive-period-two census jumps from four isolated orbits to an entire circle at discrete forcing strengths, a nongeneric identity rather than ordinary saddle-node event. The golden-ratio arithmetic proves that the two distinct base period-two orbits cannot undergo this breakdown simultaneously, and exact transverse exponents quantify the sharp linear approach. This is a motivated structural bifurcation classification of all period-two points, not an arbitrary sample, table recomputation or cosmetic rewriting of the Möbius composition formula.
